chunk_findings.detail: The exit-code contract used to be read from `inspect.getsource(A._review_gate)`, so a wrong table in the function that actually returns the review exit failed this test. It now only slices `A._answer_outcome` and never asserts that `_review_gate` or `review` calls it. A `_review_gate` that hard-codes success (or a different map) while an unused `_answer_outcome` still contains `RV.UNAVAILABLE: O.NOTHING`, `RV.ERROR: O.FAIL`, and `RV.PARTIAL: O.REFUSED` makes every assertion here pass and still ships the wrong exit code.
